description: This Java source file defines the `ModifySubjects` class which represents a command used to modify the `Subjects` of a `PolicyEntry` within a policy management system. It includes methods for creation from parameters or JSON, getters, and serialization logic, indicating its role in command handling within the policy modification context.

classes.name: ModifySubjects
classes.description: A command class used to modify Subjects of a policy entry. It encapsulates the policy ID, label, and subjects to be modified, providing methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ModifySubjects command with the specified policy ID, label, subjects, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifySubjects command instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label identifying the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the Subjects object to be applied.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the Subjects as a JSON value suitable for the specified schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the subjects resource within the policy.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command payload into the provided JSON object builder.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category indicating modification.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
